findings.message: `test_non_seeding_worktree_ticket_is_neither_reviewed_nor_lifted` uses `agent()`, which commits the foreign `tickets/foreign-ticket/ticket.md`. The `scope_fence` gate then fails Check before seed handling runs. If the `"tickets" in ticket.scope_fence` guard were removed, the test would still pass, so it does not prove acceptance criterion 5.
findings.paved_road: Leave the foreign ticket.md uncommitted in the worktree (write it without `git add`/commit) so every mechanical Check gate passes. Then assert that Check is `ok`, `seeds == []`, there is no `requisition_review` request, and no seed was lifted to main.

findings.message: The MERGE-SAFETY inputs read the seed text (`ctx.repo / path`) and `checks.json` (`ctx.repo / TICKETS_DIR / stem / "checks.json"`) from the main checkout's working tree. Only the blob SHA comes from `main:<path>`. An uncommitted edit in the shared checkout (ticket-file authoring there is a sanctioned path) can change the approvals or the text that gets validated, so the gate does not re-check what main actually commits.
findings.paved_road: Read both the seed text and `checks.json` from main's committed tree through `git.py` (`main:<path>`), so that the SHA, the validated text and the recorded approvals all come from the same commit.
